name: Dicky Saputra
title: About Me
desc: Hey, I’m Dicky Saputra — a Frontend Developer based in Jepara, Indonesia with over 5 years of experience crafting clean, responsive web interfaces. I specialize in turning design systems into high-performing, scalable frontend code using tools like React, Next.js, and WordPress. I enjoy solving real-world problems with efficient code and am always up for learning new technologies and building impactful digital products.

work_experience.jobdesk: Converted UI designs from Figma and Adobe XD into responsive, pixel-perfect web pages. Used modern frameworks and libraries such as React, Next.js, and WordPress. Applied mobile-first and cross-browser design principles to ensure consistency across devices. Collaborated with backend developers to integrate APIs and maintain smooth data flow between frontend and backend. Established and maintained frontend code standards, reusable components, and project structure. Led a small frontend team, providing guidance on best practices, performance optimization, and code reviews.

Led end-to-end program development from concept to deployment. Planned and implemented system architecture. Developed frontend and backend codebases. Integrated APIs for seamless data communication. Adapted to both solo and team-based development workflows.

Collaborated with programmers to develop complete software solutions. Handled end-to-end tasks including: UI/UX design, Problem-solving and system planning, Frontend development and implementation, Worked both independently and in team settings, depending on the project scope.
